model_output.rationale: CO-29 timely filing denial on both lines. The 277CA shows the claim (same trace TRC75364521) was accepted for processing on 2025-01-27, only 8 days after the 2025-01-19 DOS — well inside any commercial filing window. This is the clearinghouse acceptance-report proof that rebuts a late-filing denial; the fix is to dispute the payer's receipt date, not to write off or resubmit.

root_cause.explanation: CO-29 denial on both lines (835), but the 277CA shows the claim accepted for processing 2025-01-27, 8 days post-DOS — proof it was timely received, contradicting the payer's late-filing basis.

next_action.detail: File appeal with LIBERTY BELL, attaching the 277CA acceptance report (status A2/20, received 2025-01-27, TRC75364521) to dispute the payer's claimed receipt/filing date.

evidence.fact: Both lines denied CO-29 'time limit for filing has expired', MOA N211, CI filing indicator
Status A2/20 accepted for processing, received date 2025-01-27, claim amount $138.62, trace TRC75364521 — only 8 days after DOS 2025-01-19
Submission reference TRC75364521 matches the 277CA trace, same claim PA24642236, $138.62

citations.rule: Proof accepted: clearinghouse/payer acceptance report (strongest) → appeal disputing receipt date, don't plead forgiveness
Does not stop: EDI rejections don't restart clock; check 277CA history — sent early, rejected front-end, never reworked is the commonest true CO-29
